decision.reason: [ev-f92afdf0fcdc] says only that 0.86.1 fixes the formatting of Kubernetes events. That means the event output changes, but the line reports no failure, rejection, ignored setting or required operator step. So behavior-change (review, low severity) is the strongest kind the evidence supports, and calling it mandatory work would overstate it. Confidence is low because the line doesn't describe the old or new formatting, so none (no operational consequence) cannot be fully ruled out.
